gen-press-start-2p-gf-truculenta: Pixel-block fun with a retro grin. Truculenta follows in a compact, rounded plain sans, short ascenders and a tall x-height packed tight, so the pair is funny up top and sensible below.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-ubuntu: Playful, that's Press Start 2P: chunky and spaced out like pinned cut-outs, with a gentle swell in the strokes. Ubuntu does the opposite job, holding a lofty lowercase band in low-contrast lines that carry the text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-victor-mono:
Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-outs pinned far apart.

Victor Mono sits below in a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side, so the two feel like a game screen beside a tidy terminal.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-viga: Viga is a plain sans with barely any lift in its capitals and strokes free of hairlines. Viga next to Press Start 2P feels like a toy console beside a steady friend, the pixel heading goofy and the body quietly sensible.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-voces: Blocky, playful and unmistakably retro. Yet Voces answers with a plain sans of tall lowercase and close stem-to-hairline ratios, and that tidy restraint is what makes the pairing click.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-winky-rough: Fun is the first word for Press Start 2P, whose big-bowled lowercase sits pinned apart like cut-out letters. Winky Rough keeps its body height close to the capitals.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-winky-sans: Cut-out letters, pinned far apart. And Winky Sans, modern and low in contrast, keeps its capitals barely taller than the lowercase, a quiet foil to such a loud heading.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-yantramanav: Yantramanav is a plain sans with tall lowercase huddled close and spacious gaps where its rounded glyphs finish. Yet Press Start 2P carries the retro fun above it, with big open-looking bowls and pinned-apart spacing.
gen-press-start-2p-outfit: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, its big-bowled lowercase spaced like pinned cut-outs with only mild contrast. Outfit carries a longer passage in level sans-serif curves that stop short of closing, like bent cable, so the reading moves along easily.
gen-press-start-2p-plus-jakarta-sans: Press Start 2P is all retro fun, with big open lowercase bowls and spacing like pinned cut-outs. Plus Jakarta Sans would read a longer passage smoothly, its monoline sans strokes ending well apart and keeping each line precise.
